description: Lists and loads Replo's skills: written guides to which Replo tool does what, building and publishing sites and pages, brand kits, analytics, and each integration. Without name, returns every skill's name and one-line description. With name, returns that skill's full SKILL.md and the paths of the files it bundles; load one of those files by its skill directory and path, such as building-replo-pages/references/fonts.md. An unknown name returns the closest matches. Call it first when Replo work takes several steps or creates or edits a site or page, and when a Replo tool's description names a skill. Pick skills by their descriptions: replo explains which tool does what, building-replo-pages covers site and page work, and each integration's skill is named by its key, such as shopify. Works without a Replo account: call it before asking the user to sign in.

name.description: The one skill to load, by the name this tool lists (`klaviyo`), or a file a skill bundles, as its directory and relative path (`building-replo-pages/references/fonts.md`). Leave it out to list every skill.

name: skills
title: Read Replo skills
